parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AP2127K-3.3TRG1: 250 °C/W vs TLV70233DBVR: 249.2 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..85 °C vs -40..125 °C).

DATASHEET REVISION CHECK (AUD-04): Verify latest official manufacturer datasheets (DS36478 Rev. 7 - 2 (December 2017) vs SLVSAG6D (September 2010 – Revised July 2019)) for part-marking codes, transient load response, and qualification status before production release.
engineering_verdict: AP2127K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TLV70233DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) qualify as Level 1 Candidate Drop-In alternatives with matching pin assignments, compatible exposed-pad nets, and aligned core operating ratings. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 60 µA (p.5) vs 35 µA (p.5), max output current is 300 mA (p.5) vs 300 mA (p.4), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.4) vs 5.5 V (p.4), typical dropout is 170 mV (p.5) vs 260 mV (p.5), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 250 vs 249.2 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
